draft.inside_message: Happy birthday, Mum. The watercolours are far better than you let on, so please stop apologising for them and frame one. Speak Sunday at six, as ever.

artwork_brief.style_note: soft watercolour washes with light confetti, hand-painted feel

draft.rationale: Leans on her new watercolours and the Sunday six o'clock calls for warmth and specificity, in a son's plain, affectionate voice with no mention of age.
